elements.name: Azorius Senate Guild Insignia
elements.desc: Members of Ravnica's guilds typically carry guild insignia with them. A replacement insignia costs 5 gp and is available only to members of the guild. Any character can use the insignia of their guild as a spellcasting focus.

elements.name: Copper Alms-Coin
elements.desc: In Ravnica, citizens refer to their money as zibs and zinos, with 100 zibs to 1 zino. There is no central mint, as coins are created by the Azorius, the Boros, and the Orzhov.
